notes.title: Update to Demo ver 1.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41103201/41780b38483ed7ec2c2e09566fff6a7b88e9cd70.png[/img]

There have been quite a few changes to the mechanics of Alchemist's Mountain Demo. 

[list]
[*] Sophia now runs automatically without needing to hold down a button
[*] Players will notice a new mechanic where hearts discovered at full health will fill a potion meter. When the potion meter is full, the max life will be increased.
[*] Changes to several dungeon rooms to fix design flaws and improve intuitive problem solving
[/list]

If you'd like to read up on the changes in detail do [url=https://discord.gg/evilartbunnystudios]join our Discord [/url]where we post weekly on the game's progress.
